title: Tentative · Wednesday · oral storytelling, factors and work time
arrival: This is our working plan. We may adjust it to finish learning well.
note: Tentative plan for October 13–16: LST times and laptop bookings are unconfirmed. Adjust blocks when the new LST timetable arrives. No inequalities upload is required. Begin factors and factor pairs; introduce prime and composite numbers only when ready. Continue Nevermoor from the actual class bookmark. Mr. Eckert teaches French only; Mr. Wyatt teaches PHE. Monday October 12 is Thanksgiving: no school. Wednesday is a no-student-device day.

blocks.title: Arrival, attendance and check-in
blocks.notes: Attendance before form collection. Collect routine forms afterward; preview tentative day.
studentSteps: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms.
Look at today’s plan and get paper and a pencil ready.

blocks.title: Oral storytelling / Werewolf
blocks.notes: Use the familiar oral storytelling/Werewolf routine. Practise listening, turn-taking and explaining a claim using game information. Pause to restore fair play if needed.
blocks.firstAction: Listen to the shared rules and help build the story.
studentSteps: Explain your thinking using details from the game.
Reflect on one action that helped the group.
blocks.firstActionKo: 함께 정한 규칙을 듣고 이야기를 함께 만들어 보세요.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: Maths · arrays and all factors
blocks.notes: Review arrays and factor pairs for 18 and 24. List all factors systematically and explain how the pairs show none are missing. Introduce prime and composite only if ready; prime factorization can wait.
blocks.firstAction: Find whole-number pairs that multiply to make 12.
studentSteps: Build or draw an array and name its factor pair.
Find other factor pairs for the number.
Show how you checked your list.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.notes: Usual intermediate routine: outside 11:50–12:12; transition 12:12–12:13; eating 12:13–12:35.
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 바깥 놀이와 점심시간에는 정해진 순서대로 하세요.

blocks.title: Quiet individual time
blocks.notes: Preserve a calm reset; a quiet non-reading choice is available.
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading, drawing or an unfinished task.
blocks.firstActionKo: 조용히 책 읽기, 그림 그리기, 끝내지 못한 활동 중 하나를 고르세요.

blocks.title: English Language Arts · Nevermoor
blocks.notes: Continue the novel and a short evidence response. Hold a small character council only if the scene supports two plausible choices; otherwise use an inference and detail. Record the bookmark.
blocks.firstAction: Recall the last part we actually heard, or listen to the opening.
studentSteps: Listen for a character or setting detail.
Write, draw or say an idea and the detail that supports it.
Keep one question for our next reading.
blocks.firstActionKo: 지난번에 들은 마지막 부분을 떠올리거나 이야기의 시작 부분을 들으세요.

blocks.title: Work block · continue unfinished work
blocks.notes: No student devices on Wednesday. Continue paper work, reading, an Action Pack planning task or another existing assignment. Give a clear achievable stopping point.
blocks.firstAction: Choose one unfinished task and identify your next step.
studentSteps: Keep your work ready to continue.
blocks.titleKo: 활동 시간 · 미완성 과제 이어 하기
blocks.firstActionKo: 끝내지 못한 활동 하나를 고르고 다음 단계를 정하세요.

blocks.title: Planners, jobs and cleanup
blocks.notes: Keep routine cleanup around 2:00; move unfinished learning forward.
blocks.firstAction: Restore our room and record any confirmed reminders.
blocks.firstActionKo: 교실을 정리하고 확정된 안내 사항을 적으세요.

blocks.title: Classroom community
blocks.notes: Use a short check-in, appreciation or familiar cooperative game. Students may speak, draw, point or pass; keep feedback specific and avoid public rankings.
blocks.firstAction: Notice one helpful action from today.
studentSteps: Offer one specific appreciation or listen.
Name a small next step for tomorrow.
blocks.firstActionKo: 오늘 도움이 된 행동 한 가지를 떠올려 보세요.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.
blocks.firstActionKo: 자기 물건을 확인하고 차분히 하교할 준비를 하세요.

backups: If laptops are unavailable, finish paper work, rehearse a spoken reflection or plan the next Action Pack step.
Carry unfinished learning into the next suitable block. No inequalities upload is required.
LST times will be added when confirmed.
